setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 sends to the example MIDI device and plays pattern 1: four notes C, D, E and F (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65; velocities 127, 117, 107, 97) on steps 1 to 4 in C major. The channel range is steps 1 to 4, playback is stopped and the norns shows the Device page for channel 1.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Hold step 2 (2,4), tap and release step 4 (4,4), then release step 2. The range is now steps 2 to 4 and those steps brighten. Tap Play (1,8) and listen: the channel loops D, E, F (62, 64, 65). Tap Play again to stop.
steps.title: Set steps 2 to 4

steps.caption: Hold step 4 (4,4), tap step 2 (2,4), then release step 2 and step 4. The end would come before the start, so Mosaic refuses it: the footer reads End must follow start and the grid still shows steps 2 to 4.
steps.title: Refuse an end before the start

steps.caption: Tap Play (1,8) and Stop to check: it still loops D, E, F, because the refused gesture changed nothing. Then press step 2 (2,4), press step 4 (4,4) and release step 2 before step 4. The order of release matters: the footer reads End must follow start again and steps 2 to 4 stay bright. To set a range, release the later step first.
steps.title: Refuse a start released first

steps.caption: Tap Play and listen: D, E, F (62, 64, 65) loop with the same timing, because neither refused gesture altered the range. Tap Play to stop.
steps.title: Still D, E, F

steps.caption: Hold step 3 (3,4), tap and release step 4 (4,4), then release step 3. Steps 3 and 4 are bright and steps 1, 2 and 5 are dark: a correctly ordered gesture is accepted again.
steps.title: Choose a valid range

steps.caption: Tap Play (1,8) and listen: E and F (64, 65) loop with the same step timing and gate lengths. Tap Play again to stop.
steps.title: Hear the new range

title: Keep a valid range when a gesture is reversed
